selection_guidance: To choose a model for a task, call recommend_model: it applies current published guidance, checks fit and returns next_call with an input contract. Catalog order is not a quality ranking. Copy endpoint_id exactly; never add or change a provider prefix such as fal-ai/.

insights.body: Do not prompt-expand. Leave the prompt empty and let the video and reference photos drive it; if mapping needs words, send only a plain line like 'Replace the person on the left with reference 1'. Simple instructions beat enhanced prompts here.
Default for one starting still or a first-and-last-frame pair (image_url plus optional end_image_url) at 480P/768P, up to 15s.
